scope: Local protected-baseline and headroom producer; not accepted for native use

findings: An after snapshot completion timestamp does not prove all component reads occurred after worker final capture; overlapping reads can be mislabeled by a later timestamp.
The caller-owned runtime path mapping can change after validation but before it is privately copied, adopting an unvalidated path.

requiredCorrectionBatch: Record whole sampling intervals; require before observations to finish before worker start and after observations to begin after final worker capture.
Evaluate freshness from the earliest applicable observation, not merely the latest completed timestamp.
Take a private runtime path snapshot before validation and retain that exact validated snapshot through owner initialization.
Add overlap, stale-earliest-observation, alias-mutation and positive compatibility regressions, then run affected local suites.
